LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

En lien direct avec le studio de création, vous traduisez les croquis et les intentions du directeur artistique en volumes et en premiers patronages. Vous êtes garant(e) de la silhouette, des proportions et du bien-aller des pièces de la Maison.
 
VOS MISSIONS

Interpréter les croquis et les références du studio pour créer les patronages
Travailler les volumes en coupe à plat et en moulage
Réaliser et modifier les toiles
Suivre le montage des prototypes avec l'atelier
Animer les essayages et proposer des ajustements de coupe et de proportions
Faire évoluer les patronages jusqu'à la validation finale
Transmettre au bureau d'études des modèles et des dossiers techniques complets

Formation en modélisme (BTS, DMA, ESMOD, AICP, Chambre Syndicale ou équivalent)
3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que modéliste dans une maison de luxe ou de prêt-à-porter haut de gamme
Spécialisation flou et/ou tailleur, avec une bonne connaissance des matières associées (soie, crêpe, lainages, tissus structurés…)

Capacité à échanger avec le studio et à tenir les délais de collection

title: New Business Account Executive
description_clean:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 
We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Regional Account Manager to join our growing team in Germany

The Regional Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and nurturing strategic, long-term partnerships with key automotive clients. This role demands deep industry knowledge, a strong understanding of SaaS solutions, and the ability to tailor offerings to client needs in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
You will sit at the heart of a cross functional “pod” that includes sales, professional services and customer success- acting as the strategic lead and advocate for your clients. 
Key Duties & Responsibilities

Develop and execute account strategies to maximise client satisfaction and retention.
Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and new prospects in Germany and across DACH.
Act as the primary point of contact for key automotive clients, major dealer groups and Account relationships ensuring seamless communication and service delivery.
Build strong relationships with key decision makers and confidently drive and communicate how Keyloop drives measurable business impact – aligning global Account strategy with localized priorities.
Analyse market trends and client feedback to inform product development and innovation.
Manage contract negotiations, renewals, and upselling of additional services.
Collaborate closely with sales, product, and technical teams to ensure client needs are met and exceeded.
Manage every stage of the sales funnel- prospecting, qualifying and closing solutions that meet customer needs.
Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned with customer priorities and Keyloop goals.
Deep understanding of customer operations, dealership operational workflows, dynamics and growth plans. 
Prepare regular reports on account performance and progress toward targets.


Demonstrate strategic thinking ability to increase productivity YoY facilitating double digit business growth & % share of wallet.

Skills Knowledge & Experience

Fluent in German and Dutch
Minimum 8 years’ B2B sales experience in automotive industry 
Experience of using AI in Sales to enhance your sales functionality & capability


A proven track record of existing business sales gained in a technology solution sales environment where the ROI has been based on business process change/optimisation.
Able to demonstrate a professional structured sales approach incorporating Prospecting, Contact Management, Qualification, Presentation, Objection Handling and Closing Techniques.
Able to analyse a market objectively and identify relevant target prospects.
An ability to develop existing accounts together with identifying and securing new business opportunities.


Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building abilities.
Ability to analyse client data and market trends to drive business growth.


Well-developed commercial and financial acumen.


Strong negotiation skills.
Highly Computer literate and familiarity with CRM/SFA systems.

Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
 
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity.  We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
 
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
 
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
 
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.  We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Ingénieur de recherche F/H Détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes par apprentissage très faiblement supervisé : Etudes, applications et transposition des méthodes Visual Large Model à l’industrie du futur.
description_clean: Ce recrutement s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PostGenAI piloté par Sorbonne Université. Le projet est soutenu par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR), dans le cadre du plan d'investissement gouvernemental France 2030. Vos missionsAssurer une étude scientifique rigoureuse, visant à comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes.Prendre en charge l’étude complète, dimensionner les critères d’évaluations ainsi que les configurations de déploiement des modèles, mener les expérimentations associées.Contribuer à l’écriture d’articles scientifiques reprenant les résultats de l’étude et proposant des recommandations quant à la transposition et au déploiement des modèles VLM dans l’industrie.Activités principalesLe sujet traite de la problématique générale de la détection d’anomalies visuelles complexes dans l’industrie. L’industrie doit se doter d’outils d’inspection de confiance rapidement déployables en production. Les solutions d’IA supervisées les plus performantes reposent sur une activité préalable longue et coûteuses d’étiquetage d’images par des experts-process (plusieurs centaines d’étiquetages d’images). Les anomalies visuelles complexes sont : (1) des défauts logiques où les modèles doivent détecter et contrôler la logique de positionnement relatif entre différents objets ou entités de la scène. Il s’agit par exemple : du contrôle de l’absence/présence de pièces ou composants, de la détection d’erreurs de câblages etc. (2), ils sont aussi des défauts de texture, comme des opacités, des fissures, des arrachements, etc. L’activité principale du poste sera d’étudier puis de comparer les performances des modèles VLM sur la détection de ces anomalies. Les critères de couts seront pris en comptes (liés à l’inférence, à l’étiquetage, aux formulations des prompts et à la consommation électrique, etc). Les différents types de modèles (format ouvert, propriétaire etc.) seront à considérer pour l’étude.  Sur la base des résultats obtenus, des recommandations quant à la transposition de ces méthodes à l’industrie seront proposées puis valorisées auprès d’industriels partenaires de l’UTC. La rédaction, la soumission et la publication dans des journaux scientifiques sont attendues.Informations complémentairesDates pour candidaterDu 21/09/2026 au 20/10/2026Type de contrat et date prévisionnelle de recrutementContrat à durée déterminée - durée prévue de 18 mois - à pourvoir en octobre 2026Salaire mensuel brutSelon expérience et financementVolume horaire37 heures et 30 minutes par semaine - 1 607 heures par anContexte scientifique / résumé du projetLe cluster PostGenAI@Paris a pour ambition d’anticiper les ruptures de l’intelligence artificielle et d’en maîtriser les enjeux scientifiques, sociétaux et éthiques — là où les frontières entre technologie et intelligence humaine deviennent progressivement indistinctes.https://postgenai.sorbonne-universite.frLe projet porte sur le CAP 1.6 AI for Industry, qui a pour objectif de développer des méthodes d’explicabilité et de quantification d’incertitude pour rendre l’IA utilisable, auditable et vraiment opérationnelle dans les décisions industrielles liées aux risques.https://postgenai.sorbonne-universite.fr/pac/cap-1.6Bien qu’il existe un nombre de solutions important (méthodes locales, méthodes globales (Carvalho et al., 2024)), une marge de progression est encore nécessaire sur les taux de fausses alarmes. Il est donc primordial d’apporter de nouvelles méthodes aidant à expliquer les raisons d’une fausse activation. Par conséquent, un verrou attaqué dans ce projet concerne la réduction des taux de fausses alarmes et l'amélioration de l'explicabilité des résultats pour les images incorrectement classées comme défectueuses. title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description_clean: Qui sommes-nous ?Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.À propos du projet PLEIADESLe projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.Vos principales missions seront de :Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photoniqueAssurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutoratParticiper à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris  Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). description_clean:
Wofür wir stehen:

Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.
Deine Aufgaben:
Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht.

AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht.
SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt.
Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.
Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht.
Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt.
Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.

Damit kannst Du punkten:

Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.

Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung.
Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools.

Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss.

description_clean:
Unsere Mission und Kunden: Wir schaffen die Freiheit für KMUs, erfolgreich zu sein - mit Europas führendem Finanz-Workspace, der Banking als Kern mit leistungsstarken Finanztools verbindet. Kundenzufriedenheit steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns (und hier) - belegt durch einen Net Promoter Score von 75.
Unser Weg: 2017 von Alexandre und Steve gegründet, ist Qonto auf über 1.700 Qontoers gewachsen, die mehr als 750.000 Kunden in acht europäischen Ländern betreuen. Seit 2023 sind wir profitabel - und das ist erst der Anfang.
Unsere Überzeugungen: Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten und Potenzial ein. Mit über 80 Nationalitäten, 45 % Frauen im Unternehmen und 56 % Frauen in unserem Leadership-Team ist Diversität kein Programm – sie ist Teil unserer DNA. Wir haben einen diskriminierungsfreien Einstellungsprozess aufgebaut, weil die besten Teams auf Leistung basieren. 
KI bei Qonto: KI ist fest in unsere Arbeitsweise integriert (hier). Jede/r Qontoer/in hat unbegrenzten Zugang zu den besten KI-Tools. Wir suchen Menschen, die experimentieren, ohne auf Erlaubnis zu warten, KI über das Offensichtliche hinaus nutzen und wissen, wann man ihr vertrauen kann - und wann man sie hinterfragen sollte. 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join us as an Anti-Financial Crime Working Student or Intern to improve the operational processes behind Qonto’s German branch. You’ll join our Central Europe AFC team and begin with a high-impact challenge: making sure sensitive physical correspondence—including court documents, legal notices, seizures, and law-enforcement requests—is received, routed, tracked, and handled on time. As you gain autonomy, you’ll connect teams across AFC, Banking Operations, Legal, and Product while helping us build clearer and more reliable ways of working.➡️ As an Anti-Financial Crime Working Student or Intern at Qonto, you will:

Improve a critical operational process: Map our current physical-mail workflow, understand how documents move from our external provider to internal teams, and identify unclear ownership, bottlenecks, and missed handoffs.
Build a reliable coordination system: Help design and maintain clear routing rules, trackers, ownership models, escalation paths, and follow-up routines so sensitive requests reach the right people on time.
Connect teams across Qonto: Coordinate with AFC, AML, Fraud, Banking Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to gather information, clarify responsibilities, and maintain visibility on open actions.
Support AFC and Product projects: Once the core workflow is stable, help organize our Product × AFC feature-approval process, including coordinating input from multiple MLROs across Europe.
Improve how we work with AI: Experiment with AI to structure information, document workflows, prepare updates, and reduce repetitive coordination work—while checking outputs carefully and protecting sensitive information.

 ➡️ What you can expect:

A concrete project with visible impact: Your first mission addresses an important operational risk for Qonto’s German branch. Your work will contribute directly to the timely handling of sensitive banking and legal procedures.
Broad exposure across Qonto: You’ll work beyond a single team and gain insight into AFC, operations, legal, product, growth, and marketing within Germany—Qonto’s second-largest branch.
Real ownership: This is project-based work rather than a list of repetitive daily tasks. You’ll be expected to investigate problems, propose practical solutions, and turn them into sustainable processes.
Progressive scope: You’ll begin with the physical-mail workflow. As you establish a reliable process, you’ll take on additional coordination projects across AFC and Product.
Hybrid work in Berlin: Approximately 3 days per week in the office to support learning and collaboration.

 ➡️ About You:

You are an enrolled student: You may be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Economics, Marketing, or another relevant field. We are open to different academic backgrounds and do not require a specific specialization.
You are autonomous and accountable: You can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, structure your approach, and make concrete progress without waiting for step-by-step instructions.
You are organized and rigorous: You can track several stakeholders, owners, deadlines, and dependencies while understanding why small gaps matter when legal or regulatory requests are involved.
You learn quickly: Previous AFC or banking experience is not required, but you are curious about financial crime, banking operations, legal processes, and how a fintech works.
You are comfortable with digital tools: You can work confidently with Google Workspace. Familiarity with Notion is particularly useful.
You have professional English: English is the team’s working language. German is a plus, but it is not mandatory; Dutch is an additional bonus.
You are curious about AI: You are willing to experiment with AI to organize information and improve processes while maintaining accuracy, judgment, and confidentiality.

About your future Manager:You manager will be Stefano, Anti-Financial Crime Director for Central Europe and Oversight and Deputy Managing Director for Germany. He’ll give you the context and support needed to understand sensitive AFC and banking processes while trusting you to investigate problems, propose solutions, and progressively take ownership.

His background? Stefano joined Qonto in 2025 after nearly a decade in AML and compliance roles across banking and crypto, including Senior Manager for Risk & Compliance at PwC, AML and Compliance Officer at Coinbase Germany and Upvest, and earlier compliance positions at Intesa Sanpaolo and Deutsche Bank. At Qonto, he oversees Anti-Financial Crime topics across Central Europe and contributes to the governance of the German branch.
What he brings to the team? A combination of regulatory perspective, cross-market experience, and an autonomous management style. Stefano does not micromanage: he creates space to test ideas and solve problems independently while remaining available for daily guidance, brainstorming, and regular project checkpoints.

title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description_clean:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.
We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, not just the tickets in the backlog.
You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team (Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product) and own the end-to-end development of features that genuinely matter: company accounts and cash flows, banking transactions, card issuance and management, and AI-enabled accounting. You'll help shape architecture decisions, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor the engineers around you.
If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.
What You'll Do

Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe.
Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:

Multi-account cash flow management
Banking transactions and payments
Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control
AI-powered accounting automation


Build polished, responsive UIs using UIKit and SwiftUI.
Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.
Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.
Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team

Who You Are
You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.
Your experience includes:

Strong knowledge of the Swift language and at least 3 years of commercial iOS development.
Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.
Practical experience using the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern.
Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to develop skills) with SwiftUI.
Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.
Confidence with Git / GitLab, including the ability to set up and use GitLab CI/CD.
Ability to write unit and UI tests.
A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.
Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have

Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.
Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).
Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and achieving smooth 60/120fps on iOS.
Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.
Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.
An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.
Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.

Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.
Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.
Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.
Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.



Recruitment Flow


Recruiter Interview
First Technical Interview
Coding / AI assisted coding interview
Mobile System Design Interview
Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
Offer

 What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

For the first time in history, we can use natural language to control and interact with our devices, services, and applications, and we’re only at the beginning of the adoption of Voice and Physical AI across industries. Current voice interactions, however, still lack a fundamental human skill: nuanced understanding of audio scenes and environments. Navigating complex auditory scenes, distinguishing between multiple voices, or focusing on a main speaker are all part of the challenge of “teaching machines to hear like human beings.”
At ai-coustics, we’re building the audio intelligence layer and developer tooling to enable more robust and intelligent voice agents and Physical AI applications. Today, Voice AI companies like Perplexity, Retell, LiveKit or AssemblyAI use the ai-coustics SDK to prepare their agents for real-world acoustic challenges. Our models power thousands of agents worldwide and process millions of hours each month.
We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you’re motivated by developing technology that is used in practice, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how Voice AI works in the real world, you’ll feel at home at ai-coustics.
About the role
Developers find us, install the SDK, and start processing audio before we ever speak to them. Thousands of accounts have run audio through our models. Some become customers, but many sit somewhere between a first test and real production use. The opportunity is to identify the accounts with real potential, understand what moves them from testing to paying, and find what makes them grow from there.
You own that journey, from reaching promising developers and teams to converting and growing them. You use product and usage data to decide where to focus, get involved in promising evaluations early, and close startup and mid-market deals. You also experiment with outbound approaches to reach new prospects, identify ways to expand existing customers, and build and test the pricing and operational systems that make the whole motion work.
This isn't a conventional sales role or a RevOps role. It is a job for someone who wants to do both. If you only want to close, this will frustrate you. If you only want to analyse, you'll be uncomfortable when a number depends on you picking up the phone.
Tasks

Signup to paid — Carry the conversion number. Work out which trials are real, get into the evaluation early, cut time-to-value, and remove what's blocking the purchase.
Outbound — Own the motion end to end: target lists, sequencing, messaging, cadence, and the tooling. Run experiments and double down on what converts.
Full-cycle sales — Run startup and mid-market deals end to end: discovery, qualification, technical evaluation, pricing, negotiation, close.
Expansion and retention — Own NRR. Most start on one model and a fraction of their traffic. Find the next use case, catch the accounts going quiet before they churn, win back the ones that left.
Account intelligence — Build the scoring layer. Turn usage data into a ranked list, and keep the ICP current as the market moves.
Rev ops and reporting — Own HubSpot, the funnel model and the monthly numbers. You keep them accurate because we make decisions from them, and everyone from the board down reads the numbers you produce.
Pricing and packaging — Run experiments on the self-serve tiers: what's in each plan, where the limits sit, what triggers an upgrade. Ship, measure, roll out what lifts conversion.
AI-native operations — Build agents and automations across your whole role, pipeline generation to revenue operations. We already run this way and you'll extend it.
Voice of customer — Gather feedback from customer interactions so product knows what to build and marketing knows how to position.

Requirements

2–5 years in a commercial role at a startup or scale-up, ideally with an AI, developer, API or infrastructure product, where you carried a number and personally owned part of a funnel. You've worked somewhere growing fast and know what it's like when the playbook doesn't exist yet, the targets move, and nobody hands you a territory.
You've closed. You can talk about specific deals you won and lost, and what you'd do differently.
Love data. You can build a funnel in a product analytics tool, interrogate a CRM, write a query to check a hunch, and spot when a number is lying to you. We use PostHog and HubSpot.
Experiment discipline. You can design a test, judge whether the result means anything, and say so when it doesn't.
Tool fluency. Claude Code, Codex, Lemlist, HubSpot, PostHog. You're fast on the stack and faster picking up what's next.
Comfortable with a technical buyer. You can follow a conversation about latency, benchmarks, SDK integration and model behaviour, ask useful questions, and know when to bring an engineer in.
You sell the way developers buy. Our customers evaluate before they talk to anyone and respond to evidence.
You use AI daily as an operational tool, not an experiment. You build workflows with it and have opinions about where it helps and where it produces noise.
Strong copywriting skills and written communication. You're able to A/B test copy and see what customers respond to.
High agency. You're joining a commercial team still being built, with no established playbook. Your instinct should be to go and find out rather than wait to be briefed.
Commercial generalist. You're comfortable wearing several hats in a day and don't wait for someone to define the lane.
Working language is English. German is useful and not required.
Bonus: you've worked in voice AI, speech or audio before. Not a requirement, but it will shorten your first month. Our customers are building voice agents and the vocabulary is specific. Caring about sound and how it works helps.

Ownership & Autonomy: Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.

Du möchtest im HR wirklich etwas bewegen und suchst eine vielseitige Rolle, in der Du Dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst? Bei uns begleitest Du unsere Kollegen entlang des Employee Lifecycles, unterstützt im Recruiting und gestaltest moderne HR-Prozesse aktiv mit. Bewirb Dich jetzt und wachse mit uns weiter!

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung der Kollegen entlang des gesamten Employee Life cycles – vom Eintritt über Veränderungen im Arbeitsverhältnis bis hin zum Austritt.
Du übernimmst administrative Tätigkeiten, wie z.B. die Erstellung von Arbeitszeugnissen, Übersichten, Koordinierung von Terminen, etc.
Du unterstützt im Recruiting und bei operativen Aufgaben im Bewerbermanagement. Dazu zählt z. B. die Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Stellenanzeigen sowie die Vorqualifizierung der Bewerbungen und die erste Kommunikation über verschiedenste Kanäle mit unseren Bewerbern.
Du unterstützt unsere Pre- und Onboarding-Prozesse und sorgst dabei für eine positive Employee Experience.
Du bringst dich mit Ideen ein, um bestehende HR-Abläufe zu vereinfachen und sinnvoll weiterzuentwickeln.
Du hast die Möglichkeit, nach und nach weitere spannende HR-Themen und Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu übernehmen und Deine fachliche Expertise auszubauen.

Dein Profil

Du bringst eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder einen Studienabschluss mit Schwerpunkt Personal mit und hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen im Bereich HR sammeln können.
Du zeichnest Dich durch eine strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise aus und behältst auch bei vielen Themen und parallelen Prozessen den Überblick.
Du bist offen und kommunikationsstark, weißt aber dennoch mit sensiblen Daten und Informationen umzugehen und hast somit ein ausgeprägtes Pflicht- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
Du arbeitest auch heute schon digital, nutzt moderne Tools und bringst damit ein gutes Verständnis für die IT mit.
Teamwork makes the dream work: Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und bringst Dich gerne ein.

title: Senior Product Designer - Sell Online
description_clean:
Senior Product Designer – Sell Online
About the team
The Sell Online team builds the products that help small business owners run and grow their businesses online — from appointment bookings and online stores to customer management. We're a cross-functional design team embedded across multiple product squads, working closely with product managers and engineers to shape experiences used by millions of merchants worldwide. 🎥 Get a feel for our Berlin office: Take a look

Own end-to-end design across our Bookings and Online Store products — from early-stage concepts and user flows through to polished, high-fidelity UI ready for development

Work across multiple squads simultaneously, collaborating closely with product managers, engineers and other designers to keep design and delivery in sync

title: (Senior) QA Engineer - AI-Driven Testing (m/f/d)
description_clean:
1KOMMA5°
At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?
We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.
Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.
Learn about our Product & Tech team!
Deine Position
As part of our Mobile App Platform team, you will own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps, and change how we approach testing.
AI-driven QA is the differentiator in this role. Our QA team already uses AI for test generation, but we want to go much further. You will help reinvent it: autonomous exploration, smarter test orchestration, self-directed QA workflows, and QA systems that detect product risks before they reach users.
This is not a "write test cases and file tickets" role. You co-create systems and practices that enable our product teams to own product quality end-to-end and work with them to close the gaps so we can ship with confidence. Speed boost instead of speed bump.
You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release, effectively shifting quality assurance left.
Our Stack

Flutter & Dart
Appium, BrowserStack
Testmo for test case management
GCP, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro
Key Responsibilities
App Platform Quality Ownership: Own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps and testing architecture across our mobile product teams from a platform standpoint, including test strategy, execution, and production monitoring
Platform Collaboration & Support: Partner closely with cross-functional mobile product teams to shape quality practices, close testing gaps, and enable teams to ship with confidence
Automated Test Suite Management: Grow and maintain our automated test suite (Appium / BrowserStack), keeping it fast, stable, trusted, and focused on critical user journeys
Test Infrastructure Health: Keep test infrastructure healthy with minimized flakiness, faster runs, and actionable results for the entire engineering organization
Autonomous & AI-Driven Exploration: Create and scale autonomous exploration, intelligent test orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows from scratch to detect product risks before they reach users

Dein Profil

User-Centric Quality Focus: Strong focus on real-world user journeys, edge cases, and product risk rather than relying solely on code coverage metrics
Comfortable with Ambiguity: High initiative and problem-solving drive to invent solutions from scratch when no standard playbook exists
QA Architecture & Mobile Automation: Extensive experience designing scalable testing strategies and hands-on expertise with mobile automation frameworks (Appium, Flutter integration testing) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack)
Practical AI & Agentic Workflows: Active experience leveraging AI tools, LLM workflows, and testing agents for autonomous exploration, automated test generation, and defect analysis
CI/CD & Platform Enablement: Proven track record of integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to deliver fast quality signals and co-creating practices that enable product teams to own quality without sacrificing velocity
User-Centric Quality & Communication: Focus on real-world user journeys and risk mitigation over simple coverage metrics, backed by strong English communication skills to guide engineering practices
Bonus points for:
German language skills
Experience with energy systems, IoT, or climate tech
Native iOS/Android or deep Flutter/Dart architecture knowledge
Track record of navigating ambiguity
Experience in building testing tools from scratch

Benefits

You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description_clean:
MAOMAO is a fast-growing online supermarket for Asian food, combining e-commerce with content, community and social commerce.
We don't just sell products. We introduce people to new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.
As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.
Aufgaben
What You'll Do
Campaigns & Product Launches
You will plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, promotions, product launches and livestreams from idea to execution.
This includes:

developing campaign and launch plans
creating timelines, responsibilities and deadlines
coordinating content and communication across our channels
making sure everyone involved knows what needs to happen and when
keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables
identifying problems and dependencies early
reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.
TikTok Shop & Social Commerce
Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.
You will work on:

TikTok Shop campaigns and promotions
Seller Center and campaign management
livestream campaigns and activations
product and promotional planning
coordination with TikTok and external partners
identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce

Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.
Marketing & Content
You will work with our team to develop campaigns and content around Asian food, products, trends and culture.
You will help decide:

which products and topics we should focus on
how we communicate them to our audience
which content formats and channels make sense
how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels

We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better.
Team & Project Coordination
Good ideas only matter if they get executed.
You will help coordinate marketing projects across the team, keep track of priorities and deadlines and make sure projects move forward.
Depending on your experience, you may also:

coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team
improve workflows and processes
support and guide other team members
take responsibility for larger marketing initiatives
help shape marketing priorities together with the founders

There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.
Your Role Can Grow With You
We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.
Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:
Performance & KPIs
Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.
Marketing Budgets
Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.
CRM & Email Marketing
Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.
What Ownership Means at MAOMAO
Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.
It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.
It means thinking beyond the individual task.
If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.
We want someone who thinks:
What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?
Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems.
Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:
What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?
You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.
Not every idea will work. That is okay.
What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.
The mindset we're looking for is:
“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.”
Qualifikation
Who We're Looking For
We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience, but we're looking for someone who has already gained meaningful hands-on marketing experience and is ready to take ownership.
You should:

have at least 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, e-commerce, social media, content, campaign management or a related field
have fluent German skills (C1 or native-level), as you will be developing marketing for a predominantly German-speaking audience
have strong working proficiency in English
be highly organized, reliable and proactive
take initiative and think ahead
be able to turn ideas into structured plans and execution
communicate clearly and follow through
feel comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes
think in solutions rather than simply escalating problems
be willing to experiment, test and iterate quickly
be comfortable making decisions even when not every answer is obvious
have a strong interest in e-commerce, social media and social commerce
be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets
enjoy working in a fast-moving environment
be hands-on when needed
learn quickly and actively look for ways to improve

Experience in e-commerce, TikTok, TikTok Shop, social media, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management is a plus.
Chinese language skills are a plus but they are NOT a requirement.
Benefits
Benefits
What we offer

A central marketing role with a high level of ownership and room to shape how we work
Direct collaboration with the founders
Founders with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce
An existing marketing and content team to work with
Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin
Short decision-making paths and the freedom to actually implement ideas
Plenty of room to experiment, test new formats and iterate quickly
The opportunity to work at the intersection of e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building
The opportunity to shape campaigns and launches from idea to execution instead of owning only one small part of the process
Clear professional and personal development opportunities, including the potential to take on more leadership responsibility
A young, international team with a lot of passion and team spirit
Employee discount across our assortment

Interested?
Send us your CV and a short introduction telling us why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role.
We'd also like you to answer one question:
Tell us about a marketing campaign, project or experiment you took ownership of. What was your goal, what did you do, and what was the result?
It doesn't have to be a huge campaign or a perfect success. We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems and what you learn from the things you try.
One last thing: We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application – we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think.
If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you.
Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. 🌶️🍜

title: Lead Implementation & Delivery (f/m/d)
description_clean:
We're looking for an experienced implementation, delivery or technical operations lead to own delivery after a contract is signed — and to play a central role in working out what actually makes our product work for customers.
This one is for you if:

You'd rather build the playbook than wait for one to exist
You get real satisfaction from being the person people can count on — customers and colleagues alike
Making a genuinely complex, technical product work in the real world, on a factory floor and not just a slide deck, sounds like a good problem to have

Every factory should be as easy to redesign as a CAD file. RIIICO scans real production floors and turns the raw point cloud into a structured, living model of the plant — machines, robots and infrastructure recognised by AI, matched to CAD, usable directly in the engineering tools our customers already run. Line changes that used to take months of manual work now take days.
We're seed-funded, backed by Earlybird, PiLabs and seed + speed, with angels including Joe Kaeser, former CEO of Siemens.
Team: two application engineers report to you directly, and you steer our data delivery team, which has its own manager and five people.
Start: as soon as you can.
Tasks
You'll own the entire post-sale delivery, from signed deal to a customer who's live, confident and getting real value. Our customers are enterprise manufacturers, so the accounts you own are complex and technically demanding from day one. As an early hire there's no existing playbook — expect to blend hands-on implementation, delivery operations and testing product-market-fit hypotheses directly with customers.

Own the post-sale journey, from handover through to stable, value-delivering adoption
Build the adoption framework for enterprise accounts, and define what "first value" means
Keep a current view of every account: check-ins, early risk signals, retention plans
Handle escalations yourself, at both operational and management level
Own the Sales-to-delivery handover and keep capacity visible and realistic
Develop the lightweight processes that make delivery repeatable as patterns emerge
Lead and develop your team, and shape how Delivery is structured as we grow
Test the product-market-fit hypotheses Sales brings back, and feed findings into Product and Go-To-Market

What this looks like in your first six months:

Months 1–2 — run two live enterprise implementations yourself, end to end, so you know where the product and the process actually break
Months 2–3 — take over the Sales-to-delivery handover and make capacity visible enough that Sales doesn't promise what delivery can't back up
Months 3–4 — define what "first value" means for an enterprise account, and the timeframe we hold ourselves to
Months 4–6 — turn what you've learned into the first delivery playbook, and bring at least two validated product-market-fit findings back to Product and Sales

Requirements

4–6 years in technical implementation, delivery, project lead or technical operations roles, at a B2B company serving manufacturing or industrial customers
Experience as an early hire building implementation or delivery processes from scratch in a startup or scale-up
Experience owning the interface between Sales and a technical delivery team: handover, capacity oversight, and escalations you resolved independently
Enough technical depth to get fluent fast in discrete manufacturing, factory planning or industrial automation. You don't need to have done this exact thing before, but you do need to hold a credible conversation with a manufacturing engineer within a few months
Fluent written and spoken German and English. We work in English internally; customer work happens in German

You're eligible to work in Germany — EU/EEA citizenship, or an existing work or residence permit. We aren't able to sponsor visas for this role.
You'll fit if:

You're decisive and comfortable holding your ground when Sales pushes on scope or timeline — and just as good at negotiating a pragmatic trade-off without compromising commitments already made
You're pragmatic and action-first: you build the process as the pattern emerges, rather than designing the system before you understand the reality
You have commercial instinct: you notice what's working and bring it to Sales as an expansion opportunity
You're a fast learner with strong situational awareness, equally comfortable on a shop floor and in front of a senior stakeholder

Benefits

Real ESOP — actual shares, not virtual ones
30 days' holiday
Deutschlandticket
Based in our Düsseldorf office, with the flexibility to work from home
Regular customer site visits — a genuine mix of factory floor and desk, not travel every week
Real ownership from day one, with a direct line to founders and leadership on decisions that matter
The chance to define what this function becomes as we grow
A diverse, international team

Apply with your CV — no cover letter needed.
How the process runs:

Short intro call — 30 minutes
Written questions by email — about 20 minutes of your time
Deep-dive with Felix and the delivery team — 60 minutes
Meet the team, then offer

The written questions are how we get to know how you think before anyone sits in a room. They're the reason we don't ask for a cover letter.
We are an employer that actively lives equal opportunity. We're committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. It doesn't matter where you're from, what religion you belong to, your gender, who you love, how old you are, or whether you live with a disability — you're welcome here.

title: Senior Manager, Velocity Account Executives, EMEA
description_clean:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.
We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.
We are looking for people who want to build. People who are scrappy, entrepreneurial, hands-on, and hungry to make an impact. Sonatype is at an exciting inflection point, and we need teammates who can see the opportunity ahead, move with urgency, and help us shape the way the world builds secure software in the AI era.
As the Senior Manager, Velocity Account Executives at Sonatype, you will lead, coach, and scale a high-velocity team of 6 to 8 full-cycle Territory Account Executives (TAEs). This team operates at the frontline of Sonatype’s Go-To-Market transition, moving from historical inbound dependency toward a proactive, high-volume outbound hunting engine where each AE is responsible for their own pipeline creation. Managing sub-$50k deal sizes, your team is expected to drive transaction velocity, closing 50+ deals per account executive annually.
In alignment with Sonatype’s Employee Value Proposition, we are seeking a leader of "Future Builders", someone who leverages continuous experimentation, outbound rigor, and AI-amplified workflows to drive unprecedented commercial velocity. You will instill a relentless hunting culture focused on taking market share, leveraging our preventative Sonatype Firewall as the primary commercial wedge to capture new logos quickly and build a foundational installed base for future enterprise expansion.

This team is entirely self-sufficient, owning the end-to-end sales process from initial outreach to closed-won deal, with no BDR/SDR support.

Talent Development & Coaching: Conduct daily/weekly deal reviews, call shadowing, and active coaching to build the next generation of sales leaders within Sonatype.


YOU:

Proven Track Record: Demonstrated history of managing teams through high transaction volume environments (50+ deals/AE/year) with sub-$50k average deal sizes.


Outbound Hunting Mastery: Deep expertise in building and executing account-based outbound prospecting frameworks; proven ability to transition teams from inbound-reliant to outbound-driven.


Commercial Methodology & Stack: Hands-on experience with modern sales stacks (Salesforce, Outreach/Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, AI prospecting tools) and structured value selling methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message).

title: Head of Brand & Marketing (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Wir wollen die lautesten Handpulled Noodles Europas werden. Dafür fehlt uns die Person, die das kreativ führt.
Bang Bang Noodles macht Handpulled Noodles. Jede Nudel von Hand gezogen, mitten im Restaurant, so dass du es siehst, hörst und spürst. Heute zwei Stores in Berlin, Kreuzberg und Mitte. Morgen deutlich mehr: Wir bauen gerade das Franchise System auf und wollen im nächsten Jahr fünf weitere Standorte eröffnen, auch außerhalb Berlins. Dazu ein starkes Team und ein Markengesicht, das schon heute Reichweite hat.
Not authentic. Just really good. Wir erzählen keine Traditionsgeschichten. Wir zeigen, was wir können, und wir sind dabei laut. Mit Absicht.
Was uns fehlt, ist die Person, die diese Haltung jeden Tag in Content, Kampagnen und Markenauftritt übersetzt. Nicht als Verwalter, sondern als Motor.
Aufgaben

Du führst die Marke. Tonalität, Look, Guidelines, und du hast das letzte Wort bei allem, was BBN nach außen zeigt: Content, Karte, Stores, Merch, Kooperationen.
Du baust unser Content System. Formate für TikTok, Reels und Stories, ein Redaktionsplan, feste Drehroutinen mit unserer Gründerin als Gesicht und der Küche als Bühne.
Du produzierst selbst. Handy raus, drei Clips in der Küche, schneiden, posten. Du bist dabei nicht allein: Im Team gibt es Leute, die filmen und schneiden können und dich an festen Tagen unterstützen, und für größere Drehs holst du Freelancer und führst sie.
Du entwickelst Brand Momente, die Berlin mitbekommt, von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, und steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn es welche braucht.
Du lieferst Creatives für Paid Social und holst dir die Learnings zurück in die Planung. Paid selbst liegt aktuell beim Founder und kann perspektivisch zu dir wandern.
Du bringst die Marke in jeden Kiez. Lokales Marketing für die bestehenden Stores und vor allem für Neueröffnungen: Launch Kampagnen, Nachbarschaft, Creator, Events. Beim Opening bist du vor Ort, auch wenn es in einer anderen Stadt ist.
Du machst die Marke auch nach innen sichtbar: Employer Brand für unser Recruiting und Material und Playbooks für unsere Franchise Partner, damit jeder Standort so laut ist wie der erste.
Du hast ein eigenes Produktionsbudget und entscheidest, wofür es draufgeht.

Qualifikation

Mindestens fünf Jahre in Brand, Content oder Kreation, angestellt oder in der Agentur. Und du hast an mindestens einer Marke mitgearbeitet, die man erkennt, weil sie Charakter hat. Consumer, Food, Lifestyle, egal welche Branche.
Du kannst es selbst. Kurze Videos mit dem Handy drehen und schneiden, Texte schreiben, Plattformen bedienen. Kein Profi Cutter nötig, aber auch kein reiner Stratege.
Du verstehst TikTok und Instagram aus der Praxis, nicht aus Reports.
Geschmack und Haltung. Du sagst nein, wenn etwas nicht zur Marke passt, auch zu uns.
Deutsch und Englisch sicher. Du bist in Berlin und willst in den Stores sein, nicht nur im Büro.
Reisebereitschaft. Bei Openings in anderen Städten bist du für ein paar Tage dabei, das gehört zum Job.

Benefits

60.000 bis 80.000 € brutto, je nach Erfahrung.
Direkte Freigabe ohne Schleifen. Du sprichst mit den Gründern, nicht mit einem Komitee.
Eigenes Office in Berlin für Konzept und Schnitt, die Stores als Set direkt vor der Tür.
Eigenes Produktionsbudget und Freelancer, die du selbst auswählst.
Eine Marke mit fertigem Fundament und ohne fertige Antworten. Vision, Werte und Tonalität stehen, alles andere baust du.
Eine Firma, die gerade den Sprung ins Franchise macht. Was du jetzt aufbaust, wird die Vorlage für jeden weiteren Standort. Und die Rolle wächst mit: Wer heute die Marke für zwei Stores führt, führt in zwei Jahren ein Team.
Weiterbildung ist uns wichtig. Eigenes Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen und Coaching, du entscheidest, was dich weiterbringt.
Noodles. So viele du willst.

So läuft es ab: Du bewirbst dich mit Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben und beantwortest eine Frage: Was würdest du bei uns als Erstes lauter machen? Kein Anschreiben. Dann ein erstes Gespräch mit den Gründern, 30 Minuten, Haltung und Fit. Danach ein bezahlter Case: dein 90 Tage Plan für BBN, präsentiert im Store. Zum Schluss ein zweites Gespräch zu Rahmen und Vertrag. Vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Entscheidung: maximal vier Wochen.
Made loud.

title: Pflichtpraktikum Automatisierung und KI-Agenten im Recruiting (m/w/d) · Berlin, teils remote · 4 bis 6 Monate
description_clean:
Du hast schon mal etwas mit KI gebaut, das danach wirklich jemand benutzt hat, und willst nicht wieder ein Praktikum, in dem du Folien formatierst?
Dann lies weiter.
Aufgaben
Was du hier machst
Immotalente besetzt kaufmännische Stellen in Hausverwaltungen. Dahinter läuft ein selbstgebautes System: Kandidaten werden gefunden, bewertet und angeschrieben, über sechzehn Mandate hinweg. Dazu ein Wissensspeicher, in dem Mandate, Kunden und Abläufe liegen und aus dem heraus KI-Agenten arbeiten.
Das System funktioniert, und es hat Lücken. Du arbeitest an beidem.
Du baust Agenten für Aufgaben, die heute Handarbeit sind. Interviewnotizen zu Kandidatendossiers. Kundebriefings zu Mandatsakten. Prüfläufe, die melden, wenn eine Tabelle still aufgehört hat zu rechnen. Terminvorschläge, Nachfassen, Berichte.
Du entwickelst die Textqualität weiter. Die Ansprachetexte an Kandidaten klingen noch nach Maschine. Woran das liegt, ist analysiert und dokumentiert. Es umzusetzen ist offen, und es ist die Arbeit mit dem größten Hebel.
Du schließt Lücken im Bestand. Echte Fahrzeiten statt geschätzter. Datenprüfungen vor dem Import. Ein Abnahme-Test, der vor jeder Freigabe läuft.
Und du prüfst, was du gebaut hast. In diesem System sind Fehler unsichtbar: eine Spalte hat fünf Wochen nichts gerechnet, während die Oberfläche „100 Prozent fertig" anzeigte. Wer hier baut, ohne hinterher das Verhalten zu prüfen, richtet mehr Schaden an als Nutzen. Das ist die eine Regel, die nicht verhandelbar ist.
Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer. Keine Ebene dazwischen, keine Abstimmungsrunden.
Qualifikation
Was du mitbringst
Du hast schon etwas gebaut, das funktioniert hat. Ein Skript, ein Automatisierungs-Workflow, ein Werkzeug mit einer KI dahinter, irgendetwas, das ein Problem gelöst hat, das nicht deins war. Zeig es uns, das zählt mehr als jede Note.
Zusammen mit Claude & Co kommst du mit JSON und einer REST-Schnittstelle klar und schreibst kleine Skripte, in JavaScript oder Python. Du schreibst sauberes Deutsch und merkst, wenn ein Satz nach Maschine klingt. Du hast die Angewohnheit, nach einer Änderung nachzusehen, ob sie wirklich umgesetzt wurde, statt der Erfolgsmeldung zu glauben.
Welches Fach du studierst, ist zweitrangig. Immobilien- oder Recruiting-Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht. Sie sind hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Benefits
Was du davon hast

Du baust für einen echten Betrieb, nicht für eine Übungsaufgabe. Was du baust, läuft am nächsten Tag gegen echte Kandidaten und echte Kunden.
Du arbeitest mit dem aktuellen Werkzeugkasten: Claude, Clay, n8n, Lemlist, Recruiterflow, eigene HTML-Werkzeuge. Nichts davon ist Spielzeug, alles davon ist im Einsatz.
Du siehst die ganze Kette, von der Suche über die Bewertung bis zur Platzierung. Die meisten Praktika zeigen dir einen Ausschnitt.
Du bekommst ein Zeugnis mit Zahlen darin, nicht mit Aufgabenlisten. Was du gebaut hast, was es eingespart hat, was du gefunden hast.

Wie es weitergeht
Melde dich über diese Anzeige. Erzähle von dir und wann dein Praktikum starten muss, wie lange es geht, und ein Link oder Screenshot von etwas, das du gebaut hast. Zwei Sätze dazu, was daran schwierig war.
Wir antworten innerhalb von drei Werktagen.

title: Senior Product Manager - Client Experience & Engagement (f/m/d)
description_clean: Your RoleAs Senior Product Manager – Client Experience & Engagement (f/m/d) you own everything that happens after a client's first investment. You shape the digital home of our clients across web and native app: portfolio reporting, performance insights, documents, settings and self-services, and you turn it into an experience worthy of a premium wealth manager. Our clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You design how these investments are experienced, understood and told as a story in the product. Your mandate is twofold: make the day-to-day experience exceptional, and grow the relationship through digital up- and cross-sell of additional portfolios, products and account types. LIQID is hybrid by design, so you build a digital experience in which the personal Relationship Manager is natively woven in rather than bolted on. Clients should never feel a seam between their app and their advisor.What you'll do•     End-to-End Client Experience Ownership: Own the active client journey from first investment onward across web and native app. You set the vision for portfolio reporting, portfolio KPIs and performance communication, document management, account settings and self-services, and you raise the quality bar until the digital experience matches the standard of our investment products. That includes the storytelling layer for private markets: making capital calls, distributions, J-curves and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, tangible and understandable for clients. You define and evolve the North Star and KPI tree for active clients, building on our existing engagement framework (top-ups, additional portfolio and account openings, share of wallet, dashboard engagement, self-service completion) and developing it further where you see sharper signals.•     Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Design and scale the journeys that deepen client relationships: time to first top-up, second portfolio and second product adoption, additional account types (joint, kids), and share-of-wallet growth. You identify natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove your impact with honest, causal measurement rather than correlation stories. You build repeatable growth systems for the existing client base instead of one-off campaigns.•     Hybrid Experience & RM Integration: Make the Relationship Manager a first-class citizen of the digital product. You design how human advice surfaces inside the app: contextual RM touchpoints, seamless handovers between self-service and personal consultation, and self-service flows for major actions (top-ups, strategy changes, tax documents) that reduce friction without reducing trust. You measure and improve the interplay between RM engagement and client outcomes, from retention to share of wallet.•     Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Run continuous discovery with clients and Relationship Managers to understand what HNW clients actually need from their wealth dashboard. You define tracking schemas and metric contracts for the active client domain, run experiments and cohort analyses across engagement, retention and multi-product adoption, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles. You act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional squad of Engineering and Design, and prioritize with a transparent impact and effort logic that also means saying no.What you bring•     Background: 7+ years of experience in Product Management for digital consumer products, ideally in FinTech, WealthTech, banking or another trust-driven domain. Experience with engagement, retention or CRM-driven product work is a strong plus, as is exposure to native app development.•     Analytical & Technical Fluency: Hands-on experience with product analytics, funnel and cohort analysis, and experimentation. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, and attribute impact credibly. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype and compress your own cycles.•     Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction) and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid wealth experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.Don’t meet all the requirements? benötigst.  Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  Team & Events: Freue dich auf Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. Dein Profil Systemadministrator LinuxAbgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  Sehr gute Linux und IT-Infrastruktur.  Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen Turn product concepts into wireframes, then into build-ready design files with states, edge cases, responsive behaviour and interaction detail

Run customer interviews and usability tests, in support of discovery and to validate your own concepts
